CONNECTOR$FIELD_INSTANCE_HOST_HELP: Hostname only, without the scheme. Internal and loopback addresses are rejected unless this provider is meant to run beside the workload.

CONNECTOR$FIELD_NAMESPACE_HELP: Optional. Keeps this workspace's vectors separate from anything else in the index.
CONNECTOR$SSL_VERIFY_FULL: Require TLS and verify the certificate
CONNECTOR$FIELD_S3_ENDPOINT_HELP: Use the regional S3 endpoint, or the endpoint of any S3-compatible service you run.

CONNECTOR$FIELD_PINECONE_INDEX_HOST_HELP: Copy the host shown on the index page in the Pinecone console.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_VAULT_TOKEN_HELP: Use a token with a policy limited to the mount above, not a root token.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN_HELP: Found under OAuth & Permissions in your Slack app. Needs chat:write.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_SLACK_TOKEN_PATTERN: A Slack bot token starts with xoxb-.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_TEAMS_WEBHOOK_PATH_HELP: The path portion of the incoming webhook URL. It is a credential, so it is stored encrypted.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_OKTA_TOKEN_HELP: Create a read-only API token in the Okta admin console.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_GITLAB_TOKEN_HELP: A personal or group access token with read_api and read_repository.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_BITBUCKET_DC_TOKEN_HELP: An HTTP access token with repository read permission.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_JIRA_DC_TOKEN_HELP: A personal access token created from your Jira profile.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_LINEAR_KEY_HELP: Create a personal API key in Linear under Settings, API.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_LINEAR_KEY_PATTERN: A Linear API key starts with lin_api_.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_OPENAI_KEY_PATTERN: An OpenAI key starts with sk-.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_ANTHROPIC_KEY_PATTERN: An Anthropic key starts with sk-ant-.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_QDRANT_KEY_HELP: Leave blank if this instance runs without API-key authentication.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_ES_KEY_HELP: An encoded API key, not a username and password.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_TIGERGRAPH_TOKEN_HELP: A REST++ token for the graph above.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_TIGERGRAPH_QUERY_HELP: The name of the installed query that returns nearest neighbours.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_LITELLM_HOST_HELP: The host of your LiteLLM proxy, including the port if it is not 443.
CONNECTOR$FIELD_PATTERN_GENERIC: This value is not in the expected format.
